verdict.rationale: Logseq ships an in-app Marketplace dashboard to search/install/update/remove third-party plugins, plus a documented plugin API and community docs site, and a runtime probe confirms 617 published plugin packages in the official registry. Community commentary notes Logseq's ecosystem is smaller/less mature than Obsidian's, but doesn't dispute that a working plugin catalog exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of browsing/installing a plugin, and quantification of catalog quality/curation vs. just count.
